invocation.transport: Agent OS Python host worker -> MO2 documented command line -> configured executable

destructive_actions: creates and deletes only disposable profiles inside explicitly allowed mutation roots
may copy a save fixture into a disposable profile
never mutates the template profile intentionally
human_checks: runtime PASS still requires typed in-game observer evidence; an MO2/game process exit code is not sufficient

coverage.description: Windows-first deterministic session boundary: fresh profile copy, fixture copy, MO2 launch, process exclusivity, filesystem evidence delta, and cleanup/retention policy.
known_gaps: in-game actions and assertions require a typed runtime observer/driver adapter
screenshot/frame-time capture depends on configured external producers
coverage.denominator_probe: template profile hash manifest, disposable profile manifest, fixture SHA-256, process preflight, launch result, evidence delta, cleanup result.

safety.sandbox_or_scope: All writable runtime/profile/evidence paths must be descendants of worker-config allowed_mutation_roots; template-profile mutation is detected as cleanup failure.

verification.version_probe: Pin ModOrganizer.exe path/version/hash and configured executable in the project toolchain lock.
verification.output_readback: Validate skyrim-runtime-session-result-v1 and refuse G19/G20/G21/G26 PASS when typed observer evidence is missing.

ai.context_cost_notes: Use the normalized runtime-session result and evidence deltas; load raw logs only for diagnosis.

evidence.notes: MO2 upstream source documents global --instance/-i and --profile/-p plus run --executable NAME with optional arguments/cwd. Upstream also warns against simultaneous MO processes managing the same game instance; the worker therefore fails closed on configured conflicting processes.
